name: openclaw-sidebar
description: OpenClaw Sidebar Chrome Extension + Relay Server

scripts.build: npm run build --workspace=extension && npm run build --workspace=relay-server
scripts.lint: npm run lint --workspace=shared && npm run lint --workspace=extension && npm run lint --workspace=relay-server
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck --workspace=shared && npm run typecheck --workspace=extension && npm run typecheck --workspace=relay-server
scripts.test: npm run test --workspace=shared && npm run test --workspace=extension && npm run test --workspace=relay-server
